title: The Safari Fields
content: Anybody else have dreams about some sort of Outdoor Safari or Aquarium type place? It seems to be far from the "main mall" but perhaps connected just by a very long road. Side note: I dream about the safari/zoo tour setting alot because irl my fondest memories are of visiting the local zoos and museums in my home region. The "Safari Fields" seem to start with a gently rolling paved or gravel walkway with open air exhibits and large fields for the animals. It's cool and also a bit unnerving how the animals never have tall enough walls to keep them in, so sometimes the more aggressive animals get out of their enclosures. For some reason half the time it's either just before sundown or the park is closing before I can explore the gift shop at the exit. Also the tram ride tour of the Safari has some very random areas where it veers way too close to the walking pathways, often from above or below. Sometimes it even feels like I am one of the small animals that tries to hide when the tour tram makes it way around. Some animal habitats are amazingly lush, while others are just rocks, trees, and overly combed dirt. There seems to be an abandoned area in the very back of the complex, a hilly forest of dried up trees full of birdcages with small birds inside. The "Safari" most likely connects to the "Happy Aquarium" area thats been in my dreams as well.
